1. (Currently amended) A method comprising:
receiving requests and data records from a plurality of creditors to file bankruptcy documents with a plurality of different bankruptcy organizations, wherein the requests are specifically directed to bankruptcy proceedings and the data records contain debtor-specific financial information required for bankruptcy filing;
automatically generating the bankruptcy documents with the received data records by formatting the debtor-specific financial information according to the requirements of each different bankruptcy organization, wherein the bankruptcy documents are suitable for filing with different bankruptcy organizations; and
batch filing the bankruptcy documents with the different bankruptcy organizations by electronically transmitting the formatted bankruptcy documents directly to the filing systems of the respective bankruptcy organizations.

2. (Currently amended) The method of claim 1 wherein the different bankruptcy organizations are different courts with different filing system configurations, and wherein the automatically generating step includes transforming the received data records into court-specific document formats required by each respective court's filing system.

6. (Currently amended) A method comprising:
receiving requests from a plurality of creditors to file proofs of claims for debts owed by debtors to the creditors with a plurality of different bankruptcy organizations, wherein each request includes a data record for generating a proof of claim, and wherein the data records are specific to bankruptcy proceedings and contain creditor claim information;
automatically generating the proofs of claims with the received data records by formatting the creditor claim information according to the specific requirements of each different bankruptcy organization, wherein the proofs of claims are suitable for filing with different bankruptcy organizations; and
batch filing the proofs of claims with the different bankruptcy organizations by electronically transmitting the formatted proofs of claims directly to the filing systems of the respective bankruptcy organizations.

7. (Currently amended) The method of claim 6 wherein the different bankruptcy organizations are different bankruptcy courts having different filing system configurations, and wherein the automatically generating step includes transforming the received data records into court-specific proof of claim formats required by each respective court's filing system.

8. (Original) The method of claim 6 further comprising sending bankruptcy notification messages to the plurality of creditors, wherein the bankruptcy notification messages notify the creditors that various debtors have filed for bankruptcy.

9. (Original) The method of claim 6 wherein receiving requests from the plurality of creditors comprises receiving the requests using a secure file transfer protocol.

10. (Original) The method of claim 6 wherein receiving requests comprises receiving requests via a Web site.

11. (Original) The method of claim 6 where batch filing comprises aggregating the proofs of claims and filing the proofs of claims in a batch mode at least once per day.

12. (Original) The method of claim 6 further comprising:
generating a report; and
sending the report to a particular creditor.

13. (Original) The method of claim 12 wherein generating the report comprises enabling a user to request the report using a Web site.

14. (Original) The method of claim 12 wherein generating the report comprises generating an aging report specifying a reason some proofs of claims have not been filed.

15. (Original) The method of claim 12 further comprising receiving a filing receipt for a filed proof of claim.

16. (Original) The method of claim 6 wherein batch filing is performed by a server computer.

17. (Original) The method of claim 6 further comprising validating the data record.
